name: ofekron/better-agent
summary: Local, inspectable workspace for persistent Codex, Claude, and Gemini coding-agent workflows, with session orchestration, delegation, forks, and an integration SDK.
evidence: Implements a dedicated Codex app-server provider and detached runner with session resume, fork, steering, sub-session, and delegation support.
Persists Codex rollout cursors and replays native rollout JSONL after backend restarts, with regression tests covering live-run reattachment and recovered event ingestion.
Ships a public Integration SDK and Session Bridge extension for cross-session search, recall, proposals, and delegated work.
